digest.overview: Big Tech earnings dominated the window: Microsoft highlighted open competition with OpenAI/Anthropic plus a Copilot super app launch, while Meta's Zuckerberg doubled down on personal AI agents. xAI sued Minnesota over its nudification restrictions. Community chatter centered on ARC-AGI harness tweaks and Anthropic's revenue scaling.

top_story.headline: Microsoft openly competes with OpenAI/Anthropic, logs $3.2B Anthropic gain
top_story.summary: In Q4 FY2026 earnings, Microsoft detailed its own models, harnesses, and Mythos rival while confirming Copilot super app rollout this year spanning consumer and enterprise. It also booked $3.2B from its Anthropic stake.
top_story.why_it_matters: Signals intensifying infra and model competition at the frontier; Nadella positioned Copilot as the integrated agentic 'super app' amid rising inference spend.

sentiment.label: bullish
sentiment.summary: Community excited by agentic product roadmaps from Microsoft and Meta, plus Grok Voice claims; Dwarkesh notes strong economies of scale at labs like Anthropic where revenue scales far faster than compute.

frontier_labs.headline: Microsoft confirms Copilot 'super app' coming this year
frontier_labs.summary: Nadella said the app will combine chat, coding, and agentic capabilities across consumer and commercial use cases.

frontier_labs.headline: Zuckerberg: Meta pushing personal AI agents, broader enterprise play
frontier_labs.summary: On Q2 earnings call, Zuckerberg previewed personal agents that act on users' behalf and sees large opportunity in agents, APIs, compute, and internal software.

influencer_takes.author: Dwarkesh Patel
influencer_takes.quote: Ant revenue has been 10x-ing year over year, while compute has only been 3x-ing, suggests... very strong economies of scale in the model business.
influencer_takes.context: Highlights inference margins and pricing power at leading labs amid Microsoft/Anthropic investment news.

influencer_takes.author: Elon Musk
influencer_takes.quote: Grok Voice is now #1 in agentic performance
influencer_takes.context: Direct claim on xAI agent capabilities during the earnings/agent hype window.

influencer_takes.author: Ethan Mollick
influencer_takes.quote: Model + harness. We have barely begun to understand the best ways to do harness engineering. A huge amount of untapped potential even without models getting better.
influencer_takes.context: On GPT-5.6 Sol topping ARC-AGI-3 via simple context tweaks, underscoring engineering over raw model scale.

research_radar.headline: ARC-AGI-3 scores tripled with two context settings
research_radar.summary: OpenAI post shows enabling multi-window reasoning and compaction boosted GPT-5.6 Sol performance dramatically on the benchmark.

post_ideas.hook: Microsoft just said it's building its own Mythos rival and Copilot super app
post_ideas.draft: Microsoft's earnings make it clear: they're done playing nice with OpenAI and Anthropic. Own models, own harnesses, Copilot super app this year. The infra war is on.
post_ideas.why_viral: Direct tension between hyperscaler and labs; timely with earnings cycle.

post_ideas.hook: Zuckerberg bets billions on personal agents for billions of users
post_ideas.draft: Zuck: in five years, billions will have personal AI agents acting on their behalf. Meta's all-in on agents + enterprise APIs + compute. The next platform shift?
post_ideas.why_viral: Massive scale claim + Meta's infra spend creates FOMO/contrarian debate.

post_ideas.hook: xAI sues Minnesota to keep Grok Imagine features
post_ideas.draft: xAI is suing Minnesota over its broad 'nudification' ban, saying the law forces crippling restrictions on Grok's image editing. First amendment or regulatory overreach?
post_ideas.why_viral: Free speech + frontier model capabilities tension; Elon angle.
